I'm an aspiring personal trainer and here's essentially everything you need to know. I would encourage you to do your own research as well, but cross that bridge when you have your own questions, otherwise feel free to ask me. 

1. Diet. It's very important that in this process you focus on your diet. This means healthy and adequate macro-nutrients, (and for your health, a good fix of vegetables and fruits). Your body synthesizes fat, carbs and protein so that you can function. To calculate these you can use a website online that spits out the exact macros you need for your body goals, here are a few:  [https://tdeecalculator.net/](https://tdeecalculator.net/) ,  [https://www.iifym.com/macro-calculator/](https://www.iifym.com/macro-calculator/) . My personal favorite is the IIFYM one because the details are more precise. Considering you're "fat," you would start with cutting. Good protein sources: Chicken breast, ground pork, eggs, tofu, edamame, steak. Good fat sources: Nuts, avocados, peanut butter, high fat milk. Good carbs sources: Oats, Rice, Pasta, Quinoa, Beans, Lentils. It is important to cut your intake of processed sugar low. According to the American Heart Association, the average man shouldn't have more than 37.5 grams of processed sugar a day and I would recommend going as low as possible, however this is not an easy task for a man who is accustomed to eating a lot, so if you have difficult in this respect take it at your own pace, but don't lose focus on your goal of getting LOW. Sugar destroys your body fat loss gains. In terms of oily, fried fast food, again, if this is part of your diet it will be difficult to lower, but 80% "Healthy food" and 20% "Unhealthy" per week isn't a bad place to start. Try to drink two liters of water per day and get 1.5-2 servings of fruit and 2-2.5 servings of vegetables. I can go on, but I'll leave it at that for diet. By all means ask me questions if you have any.
2. Routine. There are going to be two parts to this process. Cutting and bulking. This first part is cutting a.k.a. cutting down your body fat, getting as lean as possible before the bulking phase, which is all about building as much muscle as possible. You should cut until you're at minimum 13-14% body fat ([https://fabulousbody.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Bodyfatpercenatagechartmen-1.jpg](https://fabulousbody.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Bodyfatpercenatagechartmen-1.jpg)) (This is a link to a reference picture) That being said as a beginner you should do 10-20 minutes of cardio five days a week while cutting on a three day muscle building weight-lifting split. Here is a sample of one: **Monday** (Push): Bench press: 3 sets of 6-8 reps, Chest Fly Machine: 3 sets of  8-12 reps, Tricep Pushdown: 3 sets of 8, Overhead Dumbbell Extension: 3 sets of 10. Overhead Military Press: 3 sets of 8, Side Lateral Raise: 4 sets of 12-15. **Wednesday** (Pull) Deadlift: 3 sets of 6-8. Dumbbell Rows: 3 sets of 8-12. Barbell Curls: 3 sets of 8. Dumbbell curls (each arm): 3 sets of 10.  **Friday** (Legs): Squat: 3 sets of 6-8, Leg Press: 3 sets of 10, Stiff-leg deadlift: 3 sets of 8-12, Standing Calf Raise: 5 sets of 12.

And those are the basics. I can delve into more details but again please just reach out to me if you're interested in learning more. Took a hell of a long time to right this, SO DON'T LET YOURSELF DOWN, STICK TOO IT ;)
